title: More Than PvP
description: Make pvp the best possible experience
body:
# PvP Optimization Modpack

A lightweight PvP modpack made to make Minecraft feel smoother, faster, and cleaner in fights.

## PvP Focused

This modpack is mainly made for PvP.

> **Better FPS, smoother gameplay, and less random lag.**

The goal is to make the game feel more responsive while keeping things simple. No useless mods, no extra clutter, and nothing that changes the normal Minecraft PvP experience too much.

## Why I Made This

In PvP, lag and stutters can easily mess up a fight. This pack is made to help with that by improving performance and keeping the game clean.

It is useful if you want:

* Higher FPS
* Less stuttering
* Smoother fights
* Better response time
* Cleaner gameplay
* Less unnecessary stuff on screen
* A simple PvP-focused setup

## Description

This modpack is made for people who want Minecraft PvP to feel better without adding a bunch of random features.

It focuses on performance, smooth gameplay, and keeping the game lightweight. Whether you play sword PvP, crystal PvP, SMP fights, practice servers, or minigames, this pack should help the game feel cleaner and more responsive.

## What’s the objective for this modpack?

I made this modpack so other people can have a smoother Minecraft PvP experience with less lag and better performance.

I do not make any money from this modpack. I just made it to help people enjoy PvP more.
